item.title: The Carnival Panorama arrives in Mazatlán with more than 5,000 visitors
item.description: Mazatlán welcomes over 4,000 cruise passengers aboard the Carnival Panorama. The international and domestic visitors generate significant economic activity, in this case approximately 4 million pesos. At 9:00 a.m. this Wednesday, the Carnival Panorama cruise ship arrived in the city from Puerto Vallarta with 4,451 passengers and 1,420 crew members. item.title: Mazatlán-style burritos: proportion and flavor
